title: Relying on Raw Strings for Command Routing
pattern: Using a raw string slice to route critical transactional commands or events within a routing module.
why_bad: It bypasses compile-time verification. Callers can misspell commands, leading to unexpected panics or silent failures at runtime.
detection: `match` blocks or string equality checks against raw string literals representing system control commands.
counterexample:
Parsing strings from a file directly to enums before routing:
```rust
let command: Command = cmd.parse()?;
```
source: *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* by Martin Fowler (p. 406).
